title: Photography approval checklist
summary: The visual and technical points to review before an image is treated as approved MOSCATELLI material.
contentNotice: Demonstration content for Atlas interface development; not final MOSCATELLI policy.

blocks.text: Confirm subject, crop, resolution, colour treatment, rights status and intended use before treating an image as approved material.

items: Composition supports the intended hierarchy and crop
Focus and detail are sufficient at the intended output size
Colour and contrast remain natural to the art direction
No distracting artefacts, accidental branding or unresolved retouching
Usage rights and source are documented where required

blocks.text: Technical adequacy depends on the intended placement. A social crop, a full-width website image and print material may require different dimensions and export treatment.

blocks.label: Do not approve by appearance alone
blocks.text: A visually pleasing preview can still be unsuitable if the source file is too small, excessively compressed or missing the required usage information.

items: The image feels consistent with the approved MOSCATELLI visual language.
Lighting, materials and skin or product tones remain believable.
The frame does not depend on fashionable effects that overwhelm the subject.
The crop preserves intentional negative space where copy may be required.

blocks.text: When an image is approved, keep the approved source and the decision context together so that later teams do not need to determine again which version is authoritative.
